title: Perfect complex with residue-field degree-zero fibres
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme, let $K$ be a perfect complex on $S$ [def-pc-perfect-complex], and let $u:\mathcal O_S\to K$ be a morphism in $D(\mathcal O_S)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Assume that for every point $s\in S$ the map $\kappa(s)=H^0(\mathcal O_S\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_S}\kappa(s))\to H^0(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_S}\kappa(s))$ induced by $u$ is an isomorphism and $H^i(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_S}\kappa(s))=0$ for all $i<0$. Then $H^0(u):\mathcal O_S\to H^0(K)$ is an isomorphism, and Zariski-locally on $S$ there is a decomposition $K\cong\mathcal O_S\oplus P$ in $D(\mathcal O_S)$, where $P$ is perfect of Tor-amplitude in $[1,\infty)$ [lem-pc-tor-amplitude-qcoh-test].
